questions.answer: You will get your uniform on the first day.
questions.translation: 你第一天就会拿到制服。

questions.answer: You should meet me in the lecture theater room.
questions.translation: 你应该在演讲厅等我。

questions.answer: Rail transport is becoming more and more popular.
questions.translation: 铁路运输越来越受欢迎。

questions.answer: Please make an appointment with your tutor about work.
questions.translation: 请与你的导师预约工作时间。

questions.answer: You have to make an appointment with your doctor.
questions.translation: 你得和你的医生预约。

questions.answer: The fiction books are just past the counter.
questions.translation: 小说书就在柜台那边。

questions.answer: The teacher explains the homework to the students.
questions.translation: 老师给学生们讲解家庭作业。

questions.answer: The restrooms are down the hall and to the right.
questions.translation: 洗手间在大厅的右边。

questions.answer: The student service center is located on the main campus behind the library.
questions.translation: 学生服务中心位于主校区图书馆后面。

questions.answer: The biology department is respected for its research activities.
questions.translation: 生物系因其研究活动而受到尊重。

questions.answer: You can use your laptops in the lecture.
questions.translation: 你们可以在课堂上使用笔记本电脑。

questions.answer: You need to put these books on the table over there.
questions.translation: 你需要把这些书放在那边的桌子上。

questions.answer: A new article was published regarding the university last week.
questions.translation: 上周发表了一篇关于这所大学的新文章。

questions.answer: Food that contains antibiotics provides few or no nutritional value.
questions.translation: 含有抗生素的食物提供很少或没有营养价值。

questions.answer: Many different conferences offer opportunities for volunteer work.
questions.translation: 许多不同的会议提供志愿者工作的机会。

questions.answer: You are required to attend lectures and write weekly reports.
questions.translation: 你被要求上课并写周报。

questions.answer: Computers used to be larger than they are now.
questions.translation: 过去的计算机比现在的大。

questions.answer: It is important to plan your study time carefully.
questions.translation: 认真规划学习时间是很重要的。

questions.answer: All students should submit their assignments by the end of week.
questions.translation: 所有的学生都应该在周末之前提交作业。

questions.answer: Contemporary critics dismissed his idea as eccentric.
questions.translation: 当代评论家认为他的想法古怪而不予理睬。

questions.answer: The integration of archaeologists' studies with community projects is widely encouraged.
questions.translation: 考古学家的研究与社区项目的结合得到了广泛的鼓励。

questions.answer: This is the first example of a modern and professional army.
questions.translation: 这是一支现代化和职业化军队的第一个例子。

questions.answer: Many employers cannot afford health insurance to their workers.
questions.translation: 许多雇主负担不起员工的医疗保险。

questions.answer: A representative selection will be carried out in the classroom.
questions.translation: 将在课堂上进行有代表性的评选。

questions.answer: The best student has an opportunity to require a scholarship.
questions.translation: 最优秀的学生有机会申请奖学金。

questions.answer: Formal conclusions could be established through rigorous experiments.
questions.translation: 通过严格的实验可以得出正式的结论。

questions.answer: Students can use the laptop during the lecture.
questions.translation: 学生可以在课堂上使用笔记本电脑。

questions.answer: You must be able to work in a team.
questions.translation: 你必须能够在团队中工作。

questions.answer: The government department was doing some crucial work on climate change.
questions.translation: 政府部门正在做一些关于气候变化的重要工作。

questions.answer: Stories often contain a lot of messages in our life.
questions.translation: 故事常常包含着我们生活中的许多信息。

questions.answer: You have to submit the electronic copy of your essay.
questions.translation: 你必须提交论文的电子版。

questions.answer: The museum is closed on the third Monday of every month.
questions.translation: 博物馆每个月的第三个星期一闭馆。

questions.answer: Population has a sharp rise in the recent twenty years.
questions.translation: 近二十年来人口急剧增加。

questions.answer: Houses were built for workers near the factories.
questions.translation: 工厂附近为工人盖了房子。

questions.answer: Organic food is grown without applying chemicals and possesses no artificial additives.
questions.translation: 有机食品种植时不使用化学药品，也不含人工添加剂。

questions.answer: Even with a permit, it is almost impossible to find a spot in the car park.
questions.translation: 即使有许可证，也几乎不可能在停车场找到停车位。

questions.answer: The new articles for the study and the subject are collected.
questions.translation: 收集了本研究和本课题的新文章。

questions.answer: The essay should be clear during the exam.
questions.translation: 考试时作文应该清晰。

questions.answer: The paper should be submitted by the end of the term.
questions.translation: 论文应在学期结束前提交。

questions.answer: The archeologists discovered tools which were interested by historians.
questions.translation: 考古学家发现了历史学家感兴趣的工具。

questions.answer: Protective goggles must be worn in all the university laboratories.
questions.translation: 所有大学实验室都必须佩戴防护眼镜。

questions.answer: A demonstrated ability to write clear, correct and concise English is obligatory.
questions.translation: 必须具备清晰、正确、简明的英语写作能力。

questions.answer: Well, there are some doubts about whether these events actually occurred.
questions.translation: 对于这些事件是否真的发生了一些疑问。

questions.answer: The student union hosts a variety of social events.
questions.translation: 学生会举办各种各样的社交活动。

questions.answer: It is clear that national trading system is a good thing.
questions.translation: 很明显，国家贸易体系是一件好事。

questions.answer: I will be in my office tomorrow from eleven to two.
questions.translation: 明天11点到2点我将在办公室。

questions.answer: Extension is only available under special circumstances.
questions.translation: 只有在特殊情况下才可以延期。

questions.answer: Tomorrow's lecture has been canceled due to the power cut.
questions.translation: 因为停电，明天的讲座取消了。

questions.answer: Eating a healthy breakfast can provide energy throughout the day.
questions.translation: 吃一顿健康的早餐可以为你提供一整天的能量。

questions.answer: Keeping organized class notes makes study time more efficient.
questions.translation: 有组织的课堂笔记使学习时间更有效率。

questions.answer: Optional tutorials are offered in the final week of a term.
questions.translation: 选修教程在学期的最后一周提供。

questions.answer: Before you choose your university course, you should consider your future career.
questions.translation: 在你选择大学课程之前，你应该考虑你未来的职业。

questions.answer: Many students are now studying science, technology, engineering and maths.
questions.translation: 许多学生现在学习科学、技术、工程和数学。

questions.answer: You are advised to use multiple research methods for this project.
questions.translation: 建议您在这个项目中使用多种研究方法。

questions.answer: Courses on nutrition are growing in popularity every year.
questions.translation: 营养学课程每年都越来越受欢迎。

questions.answer: Taxes from factories play a large role in some economies.
questions.translation: 工厂税在一些经济体中发挥着重要作用。

questions.answer: The vocabulary that has peculiar meanings in a special field is called jargon.
questions.translation: 在某一特定领域具有特殊含义的词汇被称为行话。

questions.answer: Students who study overseas can significantly improve their work chances.
questions.translation: 出国留学的学生可以显著提高他们的工作机会。

questions.answer: Your term papers should include current social issues.
questions.translation: 你的学期论文应该包括当前的社会问题。

questions.answer: It is a debate about the value of knowledge.
questions.translation: 这是一场关于知识价值的辩论。

questions.answer: One student representative will be selected from each class.
questions.translation: 每个班将选出一名学生代表。
